description: Audits 1-20 interdependent Solidity contracts (contracts array of {name, code}, required; optional protocolName and tvlTargetUsd=1000000) for cross-contract read-only reentrancy, centralization, and 6 ERC-4626/oracle invariants. Strictly read-only: pass optional contractAddress, chainId (8453 Base default, 42161, 10, 137, 1), and ownerTreasury to verify live RPC TVL and build unsigned EIP-5792/EOA Safe-Harbor rescue steps (90%-95% to ownerTreasury). Set tier to FULL ($12.00 USDC, default) for call-graph and findings or ESSENTIAL ($3.50 USDC) for score and counts; unpaid returns isError: true, empty contracts throws -32602, and CRITICAL/HIGH patches stay sealed until 0.15% SLA or 5%-10% rescue settlement. Use for multi-file protocols; use ingravity_auditSolidityContract for single files or ingravity_simulateDeepExploitAndWhitehatBounty without source.

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID used when optional contractAddress is supplied for live RPC liquidity lookup (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

contractAddress.description: Optional deployed EVM vault/pool address (0x...) on chainId for live RPC TVL verification and unsigned Safe-Harbor rescue bundle generation.

contracts.description: Non-empty array of Solidity contracts belonging to the protocol (1 to 20 {name, code} objects; additional items beyond 20 are ignored).

code.description: Non-empty Solidity (.sol) source code for this contract.

ownerTreasury.description: Optional protocol multisig/treasury recipient (0x...) designated to receive 90%-95% of rescued funds in unsigned Safe-Harbor calldata.

protocolName.description: DeFi protocol or project name echoed in executiveSummary.

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($12.00 USDC) returns callGraphEdges, per-contract findings, invariants, and Safe-Harbor rescue calldata (subject to Anti-Bypass sealing on CRITICAL/HIGH until proportional settlement); ESSENTIAL ($3.50 USDC) returns readiness score, grade, status, and severity counts only.

tvlTargetUsd.description: Target or declared TVL in USD used for bug bounty reward calibration when live RPC TVL is absent or lower.

name: ingravity_generateMultiContractProtocolDossier

bugBountyCalibration.description: Recommended bounty reward schedule by severity calibrated to TVL (FULL tier only).

capitalSalvageAndSafeHarbor.description: Unsigned Safe-Harbor rescue bundle or optional pre-deploy circuit breaker (FULL tier only).

contractAudits.description: Per-contract security audits and findings (FULL tier only).

crossContractAnalysis.description: Cross-contract call graph, read-only reentrancy findings, admin privilege map, and invariant checks (FULL tier only).

executiveSummary.description: Consolidated protocol score, LOC, centralizationRiskIndex, and readiness breakdown (FULL tier only).

proportionalRescueCommissionPolicy.description: 0.15% Pre-Flight SLA and 5%-10% Safe-Harbor settlement metadata (FULL tier only).

protocolSecurityScore.description: Weighted multi-contract security score from 0 to 100.

settled.description: Whether x402 USDC payment settled cleanly.

summary.description: Aggregated finding severity totals and failed invariant count.

verifiedOnChainTvlUsd.description: Live on-chain TVL verified via RPC when contractAddress is supplied (0 otherwise).

title: Multi-Contract DeFi Protocol Auditor
